purpose: Record the first controlled runtime load into physical CD-RAM bank $87 using the game's real byte loader and stock Japanese System Card 3.0.

test_payload.description: One existing authenticated Track-2 data sector beginning with H_BARTEN, reused as an unmistakable residency pattern. The disc was not modified.

details: Allow the natural H_BARTEN request to enter the game's generic byte loader at 0x6EA0 with destination 0xC660, absolute LBA 0x0010DD, length 0x0080 and return 0x6D7F.
At the loader's final RTS, after the natural load and remainder copy are complete, temporarily replace the next 0x6D7F instruction with JSR 0x29D0.
Use the loader's now-idle 0x29D0 scratch buffer for a 155-byte transient trampoline.

The trampoline saves flags/registers/direct-page and BIOS argument registers, saves MPR5, maps MPR5 to physical bank 0x87, calls 0x6EA0 for absolute LBA 0x0010DD -> 0xA000 length 0x0800, restores state/MPR5, executes the displaced stock LDA 0x6CC7, and rejoins at 0x6D82.
Lua restores the original 0x6D7F bytes and the exact post-natural-load 0x29D0 scratch contents before normal execution continues.

decision.bank_87: passes initial controlled load and short-retention gate; full bartender + menu/choice + exit/re-entry manual lifecycle still required before owned_for_english_runtime
decision.media_allocation: not yet solved by this test; the test reuses an existing read-only source sector and does not establish a production English asset location on disc
